description.message: Open the official episode in your own Chrome session.

note.message: This changes the shortcut language. Crunchyroll controls audio, subtitles, account access and playback.

installUnavailable.message: Installation is available when Chrome offers it. You can also use the browser menu.

offline.message: The shortcut works offline; watching the episode requires an internet connection and authorized Crunchyroll access.

online.message: Shortcut ready. Playback happens on the official site.

installed.message: Shortcut installation requested. Chrome confirms the result.

installDismissed.message: Installation was dismissed. You can try again.

shellError.message: The local shortcut could not be prepared for offline use.
